gstjv.title: ਜੀਐਸਟੀ ਜਰਨਲ ਵਾਊਚਰ
gstjv.subtitle: ਜੀਐਸਟੀ ਨੂੰ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਠੀਕ ਕਰੋ: ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਤੋਂ ਟੈਕਸ ਭਰੋ, ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਉਲਟਾਓ ਜਾਂ ਲਵੋ, ਜਾਂ ਦੇਣਯੋਗ ਟੈਕਸ ਵਧਾਓ ਜਾਂ ਘਟਾਓ। ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾਲ ਜਾਂ ਪਾਰਟੀ ਦਾ ਬਿੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ।

help.setoff: ਇਨਪੁੱਟ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਨਾਲ ਆਊਟਪੁੱਟ ਟੈਕਸ ਭਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਆਈਜੀਐਸਟੀ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਆਈਜੀਐਸਟੀ, ਸੀਜੀਐਸਟੀ ਅਤੇ ਐਸਜੀਐਸਟੀ ਭਰਦਾ ਹੈ; ਸੀਜੀਐਸਟੀ ਅਤੇ ਐਸਜੀਐਸਟੀ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਆਪਣਾ ਟੈਕਸ ਅਤੇ ਆਈਜੀਐਸਟੀ ਭਰਦੇ ਹਨ।
help.itc_reverse: ਇਨਪੁੱਟ ਟੈਕਸ ਖਾਤਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਵਾਪਸ ਕੱਢਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਰੋਕਿਆ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਜਾਂ ਗੁੰਮ ਮਾਲ ਦਾ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ। ਦੂਜੀ ਧਿਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਚੁਣੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
help.itc_claim: ਇਨਪੁੱਟ ਟੈਕਸ ਖਾਤਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਜੋੜਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਮਹੀਨੇ ਰਹਿ ਗਿਆ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ। ਦੂਜੀ ਧਿਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਚੁਣੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਤੋਂ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
help.liability_add: ਦੇਣਯੋਗ ਟੈਕਸ ਵਧਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਰਿਵਰਸ ਚਾਰਜ ਜਾਂ ਮੰਗ ਦਾ ਟੈਕਸ। ਦੂਜੀ ਧਿਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਚੁਣੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਡੈਬਿਟ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
help.liability_cut: ਦੇਣਯੋਗ ਟੈਕਸ ਘਟਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼-ਟੈਕਸ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਨੋਟ। ਦੂਜੀ ਧਿਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਚੁਣੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।

devices.title: Attendance machines
devices.subtitle: Fingerprint, face or card machines that send their punches here on their own. No file to export or import.
devices.step1: Register it below with the serial number printed on it (also under Menu, System info on the machine).
devices.step2: On the machine open Menu, Comm., Cloud Server Setting (or ADMS) and set the server address to {host} with port 4100. Turn the server on.
devices.step3: Enrol each person on the machine under the same number as their employee code, or save that number on the employee. Punches then arrive within a minute or two.

sales.name: Net sales
sales.what: Taxable value of tax invoices and paid counter bills in the period, less credit notes and counter returns. Cancelled documents are left out.
sales.formula: invoice lines + counter lines (quantity not returned) - credit note lines, all at taxable value
sales.limits: Counter bills carry no customer, so they are missing from customer rankings.

pieces.name: Pieces sold
pieces.what: Quantity of goods sold in the period, net of returns.
pieces.formula: sum of quantity on the same sale lines, goods only
pieces.limits: Services and trims are not counted as pieces.

bills.name: Bills
bills.what: Number of tax invoices plus paid counter bills in the period.
bills.formula: count(invoices not cancelled) + count(counter bills paid)
bills.limits: Credit notes do not reduce the count.

avgBill.name: Average bill value
avgBill.what: Net sales divided by the number of bills.
avgBill.limits: Sales is net of returns but the bill count is not.

avgRate.name: Average rate per piece
avgRate.what: Net sales divided by pieces sold.
avgRate.limits: Sales includes service lines while pieces counts goods only, so services raise the rate.

grossProfit.name: Gross profit on standard cost
grossProfit.what: Net sales less the standard cost of the goods sold, where standard cost is each item's purchase rate today. The books' trading account remains the place for profit after stock valuation.
grossProfit.formula: net sales - sum(goods quantity x item purchase rate)
grossProfit.limits: Uses the current purchase rate, not the cost the stock was bought at. Service sales carry no cost, so they count as full margin.

profitPct.name: Gross margin
profitPct.what: Gross profit as a percentage of net sales.
profitPct.limits: Blank when there are no sales in the period.

purchases.name: Purchases
purchases.what: Taxable value of purchase bills in the period. Cancelled bills are left out.
purchases.formula: sum of purchase bill line taxable value

stockValue.name: Stock value
stockValue.what: Value of stock on hand at the end of the period, by the business's chosen valuation method.
stockValue.formula: stock summary as at the period end date
stockValue.limits: Stock is not posted to the ledger, so this cannot be compared with a ledger balance.

receivable.name: Receivables
receivable.what: What customers owe at the end of the period: the sum of positive customer balances.
receivable.formula: sum of outstanding balances above zero, receivable side, as at the end date
receivable.limits: Customers who have paid in advance (negative balances) are not netted off.

payable.name: Payables
payable.what: What the business owes suppliers at the end of the period: the sum of positive supplier balances.
payable.formula: sum of outstanding balances above zero, payable side, as at the end date
payable.limits: Advances paid to suppliers are not netted off.

lastYear.name: Same period last year
lastYear.what: Every comparison on the insights page is to the same dates one year earlier.
lastYear.formula: from and to shifted back one calendar year
lastYear.limits: A leap day can make the two periods differ by one day.

does.invoice: The bill. The customer now owes this amount. Stock goes down unless a delivery challan already did it.
does.creditNote: A return or price reduction against an invoice. It lowers what the customer owes.

savedEffect.quotation: Total {total}. No stock or accounts changed.
savedEffect.order: Total {total}. Stock has not moved yet.
savedEffect.invoice: Total {total}. The customer now owes this. Stock went down unless a delivery challan already did it.

home.noShortcuts: Nothing pinned yet. Open any menu on the left and tap the star next to a screen to pin it here.
home.noRecent: Screens you open will show up here.

does.order: What you asked the supplier to send. Stock and accounts do not change yet.
does.receipt: Goods that arrived. Stock goes up now. The supplier's bill is booked separately.
does.bill: The supplier's invoice. You now owe this amount. Stock goes up unless a goods receipt already did it.
does.return: Goods sent back to the supplier. Stock goes down and it lowers what you owe.

savedEffect.order: Total {total}. Stock has not moved yet.
savedEffect.receipt: Stock has gone up. Book the supplier's bill when it arrives.
savedEffect.bill: Total {total}. You now owe the supplier this. Stock went up unless a goods receipt already did it.

drawer.discard: Close without saving? What you typed will be lost.

gstfile.dates: {ret} was due on {due}. It can be filed up to {last}, three years after the due date.
gstfile.barred: {ret} for {period} can no longer be filed. The three-year window closed on {date}. Tax can still be demanded on this period.

basis.books: Credit is taken from the purchase bills in the books. Compare it with the statement below before filing.
basis.2b: Credit is limited to what the GSTR-2B statement shows. A bill earns the lower of the books and the statement. Queried rows, rows the statement marks not available, statement rows with no bill in the books and bills missing from the statement are held back.

gstfile.noImport: No GSTR-2B statement has been imported for this period, so credit is taken from the books. Import the statement under GST compliance.

rows.queried: Held back: queried with the supplier
rows.notAvailable: Held back: statement says not available
rows.inStatementNotInBooks: Held back: on the statement, no bill in the books
rows.inBooksNotInStatement: Waiting: bill in the books, not on the statement

gstcompare.title: GSTR-3B side by side
gstcompare.help: Type what the portal pre-filled and what was finally filed. The differences from the ERP show beside each line. Saving these never reopens the review of the return.

gstamend.title: Amendments to earlier supplies
gstamend.help: Correct an invoice, credit or debit note, or B2C summary from an earlier month. It is reported in this return in the amendment table (B2BA, CDNRA or B2CSA), against the original it replaces.
gstamend.taxableHint: Tax is worked out from the rate.

errors.invalid_period: The return period is not valid.
errors.invalid_gstin: The buyer's GSTIN is not valid.
errors.original_required: Give the number and date of the original.
errors.corrected_required: Give the corrected number and date.
errors.original_not_earlier: The original must be from an earlier month than this return. A correction within the same month is made before filing.
errors.original_period_required: Give the month first reported, as MMYYYY.
errors.note_type_required: Choose credit note or debit note.
errors.invalid_rate: Choose a GST rate from the list.
errors.igst_on_intra: A supply within the state carries CGST and SGST, not IGST.
errors.cgst_sgst_on_inter: A supply to another state carries IGST, not CGST and SGST.
errors.tax_does_not_match_rate: The tax does not follow the rate.
errors.workpaper_filed_reopen_first: This return is already filed. Reopen it before changing amendments.

flags.billed_more_than_received: Billed {excess} more than was received. Ask the supplier for a credit note.
flags.rate_differs: Billed rate differs from the order by {diff} a piece.

scorecard.title: Supplier scorecard
scorecard.subtitle: How each supplier did on orders in the range: on time, in full, short and damaged goods, and billed against ordered rates.
scorecard.note: On time counts receipts by the expected date on the order, so orders without one are left out of it. In full is received against ordered. Claim value is short, damaged and returned goods at the receipt rate.

poApproval.waitingTitle: This order is waiting for approval
poApproval.waitingHelp: It is above the approval limit. Nothing can be received or billed on it until someone with the approve right accepts it.
poApproval.limitHelp: Orders above this value wait for someone with the purchase approve right. People who have that right are never held up by it.

errors.order_not_waiting: This order is not waiting for approval.
errors.reason_required: Give a reason for rejecting it.
errors.order_not_approved: This purchase order has not been approved, so goods cannot be received or billed on it.
errors.invalid_amount: Enter the limit as a rupee amount.

quotes.title: Quote comparison
quotes.subtitle: Prices suppliers have quoted for one item, side by side, cheapest landed cost first.
quotes.pick: Choose an item to compare its quotes.
quotes.none: No quotes recorded for this item.
quotes.lastPaid: Last paid {rate} a piece to {supplier} on {date}.
quotes.neverBought: This item has not been bought before.
quotes.note2: Landed cost is the quoted rate plus the freight and other cost you expect, before GST, because GST on purchases is recovered as credit. Expired quotes are shown last and never marked cheapest.

errors.valid_before_quoted: The quote cannot be valid until a date before it was given.
errors.unknown_supplier: Choose a supplier from the list.
errors.unknown_item: Choose an item from the list.

reconOverview.title: Reconciliation overview
reconOverview.subtitle: Every place the books must agree with something else, in one list.

overall.ok: Everything that could be compared agrees.
overall.differs: Something does not agree. Open the rows marked Differs.

customers.name: Customers
customers.what: Customer ledgers against the receivables report.

suppliers.name: Suppliers
suppliers.what: Supplier ledgers against the payables report.

stock.name: Stock
stock.what: Stock register value against the stock ledger.

bank.name: Bank
bank.what: Bank statement lines not yet matched to an entry.

gst.name: GST credit
gst.what: Input credit in the books against the GSTR-2B statement for {period}.

reconOverview.note: A difference of a rupee is treated as rounding. Customers and suppliers can differ when a party has paid in advance, because the report settles payments against bills. Bank has no second figure: it counts statement lines still waiting to be matched.

recurring.title: Recurring entries
recurring.subtitle: Rent, loan instalments, subscriptions and other entries that repeat. They post as ordinary vouchers.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.dayHint: A day past the end of a short month falls on its last day.
recurring.note: Each due date posts one voucher, once; pressing the button again never posts the same date twice. A date that cannot be posted, for example in a locked period, stays due and is shown here. Entries before today catch up, up to a year at a time.

errors.at_least_two_lines: An entry needs a debit and a credit.
errors.voucher_not_balanced: Debit and credit must be the same amount.
errors.ends_before_start: The end date is before the start date.

reservations.title: Stock set aside for this order
reservations.help: Setting aside takes only what is free, in line order. Delivering a line lets its stock go by itself. It stops other orders from taking the same pieces; it does not lock the godown.

errors.order_not_open: This order is closed or cancelled, so no stock can be set aside for it.

backorders.title: Backorders
backorders.subtitle: What open orders want that no stock has been set aside for.
backorders.empty: No order is waiting for stock.
backorders.note: Free stock is normally set aside from the order page, so most of what is left here is stock you do not have. Purchase orders waiting for approval are not counted as arriving.

bins.title: Bins
bins.subtitle: Where pieces sit inside a godown. A bin is a place, not a second stock count.
bins.none: No bins in this godown yet.
bins.unplacedTitle: In stock, not in any bin
bins.allPlaced: Everything in stock has a bin.
bins.driftTitle: Bins hold more than the godown does
bins.driftOne: {item}: {assigned} shelved in bins, {stock} in stock. Recount and correct the bins.

errors.bin_exists: That bin code already exists in this godown.
errors.more_than_unplaced: That is more than is in stock and not already in a bin.
errors.more_than_in_bin: That is more than the bin holds.
errors.bin_not_empty: Empty the bin before removing it.
errors.different_warehouse: Bins must be in the same godown.
errors.unknown_warehouse: Choose a godown from the list.

picking.title: Pick lists
picking.subtitle: The walk through the bins for an order, checked by scanning.
picking.emptyHint: Make one from a sales order once stock is set aside for it.
picking.unplaced: Lines with no bin: {count}. The picker has to find them in the godown.

result.wrong: {code} is not on this list. Put it back.
result.extra: {code} is already complete on this list. That is one too many.

picking.doneShort: Picking is done, with lines short.

errors.nothing_to_pick: Nothing is left to list. Set stock aside for the order first, or it is already on a list.
errors.order_not_open: This order is closed or cancelled.
errors.pick_list_not_open: This list is already finished or cancelled.
errors.unknown_warehouse: Choose a godown from the list.

deliveryProof.title: Proof of delivery
deliveryProof.none: No proof of delivery recorded yet.
deliveryProof.photoHint: A picture of the signed challan or the parcel.
deliveryProof.anyProblem: Anything short or damaged? Leave blank if not.
deliveryProof.claimLine: Claim owner: {owner}. Raise the claim by {deadline}.
deliveryProof.pageSubtitle: Claims for short or damaged goods still open, and challans with no proof of delivery.
deliveryProof.noneAwaiting: Every recent challan has its proof.
deliveryProof.pageNote: A claim is due a week after the goods were received. Only challans sent as a supply are chased, a few days after they leave.

errors.proof_exists: Proof is already recorded for this challan.
errors.received_before_dispatch: The goods cannot be received before they were sent.
errors.received_in_future: The date received cannot be in the future.
errors.more_than_delivered: Short and damaged together cannot be more than was delivered.
errors.evidence_file_not_found: The photo could not be found. Attach it again.

inspection.title: Return inspection
inspection.subtitle: Goods customers sent back, waiting in Quality hold to be restocked or written off.
inspection.inspectFirst: Inspect the goods before they go back on the shelf
inspection.note: Tick the inspect option when recording a return or a credit note for goods. Those goods go to Quality hold instead of the shelf, so they cannot be sold until you decide. A large write-off may wait for an approver. What you do not decide stays on hold.

errors.nothing_decided: Enter how many to restock or write off.
errors.more_than_remaining: That is more than is still waiting.
errors.restock_godown_required: Choose a godown to restock into.
errors.unknown_warehouse: Choose a different godown to restock into.

gstr9.title: GSTR-9 annual return working, {fy}
gstr9.due: Due {date}. Cannot be filed after three years from the due date.
gstr9.basisHint: Your accountant decides this. Both figures are shown below.
gstr9.accountant: This is a working, not a filing. Which source Table 8A should use for the year is for your accountant to confirm; change it here and check both figures.

dNote.available_not_availed: Credit was available but not taken. Check whether it can still be claimed.
dNote.availed_more_than_available: More credit was taken than Table 8A shows. Find the documents before filing.

gstr9.missing2b: No GSTR-2B statement is imported for {count} months of this year, so the 2B figure is incomplete. Import the missing statements before relying on it.

nc.lastYearTransactionsReportedThisYear: last year's items reported this year

packingList.title: Packing list
packingList.complete: {boxes} cartons, {pieces} pieces: agrees with the challan
packingList.problems: {count} items do not agree with the challan
packingList.none: No cartons are listed for this challan yet.

errors.packing_box_not_packed: Only a packed carton can be added. Pack it first.
errors.packing_box_on_challan: This carton is on a packing list. Take it off before reopening it.
errors.packing_box_on_other_challan: This carton is already on another challan's packing list.

scanReceive.title: Receive order {number} by scanning
scanReceive.subtitle: Scan each piece or type a code and a count. Short and extra goods show as you go; nothing is saved until you make the receipt.
scanReceive.notOnOrder: Not on this order and left out of the receipt: {items}.
scanReceive.make: Make goods receipt from these counts
scanReceive.partial: The order is not fully received; the rest can be received later.

errors.order_not_open: This order is cancelled or closed, so nothing can be received against it.

i.saleByGroup: Sale and purchase by party group
i.saleByCategory: Sale and purchase by item category

reportLists.transactionsHint: Every sale, purchase, return and payment of the period in one list.
reportLists.dayBookHint: One day: what was billed and the money that came in and went out.
reportLists.billProfitHint: What each sale invoice made after the cost of the goods in it.
reportLists.billProfitNote: Cost is the real cost from the stock ledger where it is known; "Estimated" rows use the item's standard cost.
reportLists.gstRateHint: Tax charged on sales and paid on purchases, for each GST rate, net of returns.
reportLists.none: Nothing to show for this period.

settingsUi.title: Settings
settingsUi.readOnly: You can see these options but not change them. Ask someone who can edit settings.

hint.general: The business, its books, its data and how the screen looks on this device.
hint.transaction: Numbering, approvals, locks and counter and expense settings.
hint.print: What the printed tax invoice and quotation show, the paper and the colour.
hint.taxes: GST, HSN codes, and tax collected or deducted at source.
hint.message: Message templates and what has been sent to customers and suppliers.
hint.party: Customers, suppliers, price lists and loyalty.
hint.item: Sizes and colours, items, margins and stock limits.
hint.accounting: The chart of accounts, posting defaults and closing the period.
hint.defaultPrinter: A tax invoice goes to this printer first.
hint.direct: Works when printing directly to the printer.
hint.agent: The print agent runs on the counter computer (see tools/print-agent). Printer address: 192.168.1.50:9100 for a network printer, or usb:ShareName for a USB printer shared on Windows.
hint.names: Give each kind of document the name your business uses. Leave a box empty to keep the standard name.
hint.upi: Shown on the invoice when an amount is still due.

group.deducted: Tax collected and deducted at source

pref.roundOff: Round off the total to the nearest rupee
pref.repeatHeader: Print repeat header in all pages

errors.invalid_preferences: That setting could not be saved.
errors.set_passcode_first: Set a passcode first, then turn this on.
errors.logo: That picture could not be used. Choose a PNG or JPEG file that is not very large.

scale.title: Screen size
scale.hint: Make everything on screen larger or smaller on this computer. It does not change anyone else's screen.

prefHint.blockNegativeStock: A sale invoice, delivery challan or counter bill that would take an item below zero is refused, and nothing is saved.
prefHint.roundOff: Sale invoices are rounded to a whole rupee, with the difference shown as Round off. Turn off to keep the paise.
prefHint.passcodeOnCancel: Cancelling a sale, purchase, stock or accounts document asks for the business passcode. Set the passcode below first.
prefHint.amountDecimals: Used for amounts on printed documents and in report lists. Books keep paise whatever is shown.
prefHint.theme: The tax invoice layout, or the counter receipt layout on the paper roll.

layout.landscapeNote: Landscape layouts print on a wide page, so the page turns to landscape.

field.upiId: UPI ID (for the pay-now QR code)

reportDefs.choosePartyNote: Choose a party to see the statement.
reportDefs.chooseItemNote: Choose an item to see its day by day movement.
reportDefs.allLow: All items at or below the minimum
reportDefs.none: Nothing to show for this period.
reportDefs.abcNote: Items are ranked by what they sold for in the last year. A items make the first 80% of sales and should be counted every month, B the next 15% every three months, C the rest every six months.
reportDefs.likelyDueNote: Customers with at least three orders in the last eighteen months whose usual gap between orders has passed. The most overdue come first.
reportDefs.noBank: No bank account has been set up yet.

passcode.title: Passcode needed
passcode.help: Cancelling a document needs the business passcode.
passcode.hint: Four to eight digits. Once Passcode to cancel documents is turned on, cancelling a sale, purchase, stock or accounts document asks for it. Five wrong tries lock the person out for five minutes.

errors.invalid_passcode: The passcode must be four to eight digits.
errors.passcode_wrong: The current passcode is not right.
